key_insight: Test-Time Baking (TTB) compresses global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP. This aims to make novel-view rendering faster while retaining high image quality.
problem_solved: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models deliver strong rendering quality but incur substantial computation, even with KV caching. Existing Test-Time Training layers reduce computation at the cost of quality.
method: Use cross-view attention to capture global scene information from input views.
Learn to bake that information into a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) at test time.
Use the baked representation for efficient novel-view decoding without explicitly reconstructing 3D geometry.
impact: TTB offers a route toward faster, high-fidelity view synthesis for compute-sensitive applications. The supplied abstract is truncated, so specific implementation details and measured speedups are unavailable.

paper_title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
paper_authors: Chin-Yang Lin, Ryo Hachiuma, Jaesung Choe, Min-Hung Chen, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
